description: Get current/real-time weather conditions for a location — temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, precipitation probability, cloud cover, UV index, and visibility. Location can be "lat,lon" coordinates or a city name. Example: realtime({ location: "new york", units: "imperial" }) or realtime({ location: "40.71,-74.01" })

_apiKey.description: Tomorrow.io API key (optional — get a free one at tomorrow.io; if omitted the platform key is used)

location.description: Location to look up — either "lat,lon" coordinates (e.g. "40.71,-74.01") or a city name (e.g. "new york", "london")

name: realtime
title: Realtime
